info.name: API REST - Gestion de Projets et Tâches
info.description:
Organized Postman collection for the Node.js / Express / MongoDB / JWT project-and-task management API.

Original URLs, tokens, credentials and variables are preserved exactly as in the source collection (base URL: http://localhost:3000). Tokens are test JWTs and may be expired: log in again via the Authentication folder to get a fresh one.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Public endpoints used to create accounts and obtain a JWT: POST /api/auth/register and POST /api/auth/login.

request.description:

**Role:** Any visitor (no role).
**Parameters:** JSON body fields: login, password.
**Successful response:** A 2xx response means the credentials were accepted; the response is expected to contain the JWT used as Bearer token in other requests. An error status means the credentials were rejected.

item.name: 2. Users / Manager
item.description: Reserved for Manager/User-management requests. The original collection contains no request targeting a user-management endpoint, so this folder is intentionally empty (no endpoint was invented). Manager/User role usage appears in the tokens of other requests (see their descriptions).

item.name: 3. Projects

request.description:

**Role:** Depends on the token stored in {{json_web_token_14qh}}; the role is not recorded in the original collection.

**Successful response:** A 200/201 response means the resource was created and returned in the JSON body.

item.name: 6. Security & Authorization
item.description: Requests that verify authentication and authorization behavior: protected routes, missing tokens, role and ownership checks.

item.name: Protected Routes
item.description: Routes that require a valid Bearer token.

request.description:
Calls the protected test route to verify that a valid Bearer token grants access.

**Method:** GET
**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:3000/api/test-protected`
**Authentication:** Required - Bearer token (original token kept in the request).
**Role:** Used with a "user" role token (role claim of the original token). Roles permitted by the API are not recorded in the collection.
**Parameters:** None.
**Successful response:** 200 OK means the Bearer token was accepted by the authentication middleware; 401 means it was missing/invalid.

item.name: Unauthorized Access
item.description: Requests sent without (or with an empty) token; a 401 is expected.

item.name: Security - Get Filtered Tasks Without Token #1

request.description:
Calls the filtered task-list endpoint with an empty Bearer token to verify that unauthenticated access is rejected.

**Method:** GET
**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:3000/api/tasks/project/6afb1a3f56a6023b9e798bb3?search=page&status=doing&sortBy=deadline&order=asc`
**Authentication:** Bearer authorization is configured but the token is intentionally EMPTY (negative test).
**Role:** None (unauthenticated).
